function.name: concert_finder
function.description: Locate upcoming concerts based on music genre in specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

The user wants to find upcoming concerts in the next month in California San Francisco and New York for rock and jazz. We need to call the function concert_finder twice? Actually we need to find concerts in two cities: San Francisco (CA) and New York (NY). For each city, we need to find concerts for both rock and jazz. So we might need to call the function four times: location=San Francisco, CA, music_genre=rock; location=San Francisco, CA, music_genre=jazz; location=New York, NY, music_genre=rock; location=New York, NY, music_genre=jazz. Or maybe we can combine? The function signature expects location string, music_genre string, time_period optional. It doesn't support multiple genres or multiple locations. So we need separate calls.

We should call the function with location "San Francisco, CA" and music_genre "Rock". Then again with "San Francisco, CA" and "Jazz". Then "New York, NY" rock, then "New York, NY" jazz.
